discrepancies.type: input construction (non-numeric; not a section-9 1e-6 item)
discrepancies.what: 24Q2 query set: 102 sealed REP.1M compounds have >=1 measured L1000 option under the run's own identity rule (LINCS trt_cp inchi_key_prefix = connectivity block, pert_idose '10 uM'); the frozen l1000_24q2.npz and the run use 101.
discrepancies.missing_compound: BRD-K57796080 (3,5-DHPG-(S)), connectivity block HOOWCUZPEFNHDT, shared with query BRD-A20589515 (dihydroxyphenylglycine; 7 core-line 10 uM signatures)
discrepancies.explanation: keys_24q2.tsv / l1000_24q2.npz keep one Broad ID per connectivity block (first in the sealed file); the de-duplication is not written in PROTOCOL.md, but the protocol's census count (101) matches it and the file is hash-bound and dated 04:20Z, before the freeze and before the 24Q2 download, so the choice cannot depend on outcomes. The other shared block (A-804598, two Broad IDs) has no L1000 data.
discrepancies.impact: Unknown without reading one more sealed 24Q2 row (not done, to keep the remaining sealed compounds unread). Its enantiomer is inactive (17 of 568 killed lines; 29 needed). If it were active it would carry the same predictions as BRD-A20589515; the 24Q2 point estimate turns negative only if its per-compound difference is below -0.467 (H1) or -0.584 (H3); observed range over the 32 actives is -0.154 to +0.134 (H1) and -0.133 to +0.183 (H3).

ambiguities.rule: Secondary hit precision: number of hits ('the 10% of evaluated lines') and which lines are evaluated
ambiguities.reading_used: nearest integer to 0.1 x n, ties to even (Python round), n = lines where both residuals are finite
ambiguities.result: reproduces every per-compound hit precision exactly (0 difference)
ambiguities.alternatives: floor or ceil: per-compound differences up to 0.333 (NCI-60) and 0.034-0.036 (24Q2); round half up: 0.035 on 24Q2. Under floor, secondary C1-B0 = +0.0069 (p 0.27) and C1-B1 = +0.0105 (p 0.12) on NCI-60 vs reported +0.0088 / +0.0152; 24Q2 +0.0041 / +0.0035 vs +0.0069 / +0.0067. No decision depends on the secondary endpoint.
ambiguities.disclosure: the verifier's first implementation used floor and failed 16 checks; the reading was changed after seeing that, because the protocol does not specify rounding

ambiguities.rule: 24Q2 activity: denominator of '5% of the evaluated lines'
ambiguities.reading_used: all 568 lines (missing = not <= -1), as the protocol's parenthesis implies; reproduces 32 actives
ambiguities.alternatives: lines with a value: 33 actives (adds BRD-K00003381: 28 killed of 544 measured); H1 +0.0147 (p 0.104), H3 +0.0208 (p 0.028): still not Holm-significant, point estimates positive, verdicts unchanged

ambiguities.rule: 24Q2 lines 'present in both the 19Q4 pool and the 24Q2 matrix'
ambiguities.alternatives: matching the base ID of 4 pool lines flagged _FAILED_STR (ACH-000010, -000511, -000925, -000992): 572 lines, same 32 actives, H1 +0.0146 (p 0.111), H3 +0.0186 (p 0.044); verdicts unchanged
-log10(2.5e-6) = 5.60206 changes 32 killed-line cells and no activity flag; 53 line means lie exactly at 5.60, so summation order could matter, but the counts reproduced exactly

ambiguities.reading_used: the frozen inputs use the nominal LINCS label pert_idose '10 uM' (verified: n_sig equal for all 448 + 1227 keys)
ambiguities.alternatives: exact pert_dose == 10 uM would leave 7 NCI-60 keys (419 -> 412) and 2 24Q2 queries (101 -> 99) without a measured option and change signatures of others; not testable without the 23 GB gctx

ambiguities.reading_used: one numpy default_rng(20261031); NCI-60: a permutation of the reference indices per fold in fold order 0-9; 24Q2: one permutation of the 1,403 references (reproduced to 5e-15)
ambiguities.alternatives: a fresh generator per fold, seed+fold, or RandomState do not reproduce pred_L (not a protocol issue)

ambiguities.reading_used: verifier's own default_rng integer resampling, 10,000 resamples per contrast
ambiguities.result: all 12 reported intervals agree within 0.0016 (tolerance 0.005); the study's exact draws are not reproduced with default_rng(20261031) integer draws (differences up to 0.00095)

notes: C1 needs the query centred on the reference mean before the top-5 directions are removed; without that centring predictions differ by up to 1.03 (all 419 rows). The protocol's wording supports centring both.

Closest neighbour-set call: the k-th vs (k+1)-th similarity gap reached 5.4e-7 (C1, NCI-60) and 2.2e-6 (C1, 24Q2); the verifier's float64 implementation still selected identical neighbours everywhere.

The leakage arm L beats the zero arm on the secondary endpoint (hit precision on actives 0.121 NCI-60, 0.120 24Q2 vs 0.10; one-sided one-sample p 0.003 and 0.004), so 0.10 understates the chance level of hit precision; the primary leakage rule is unaffected (L mean r 0.0137, p 0.236; -0.0116, p 0.259).

RESULTS.json omits contrasts the protocol lists: every arm vs Z (primary and secondary) and the secondary context contrasts (C1-B2, B1-B0). The verifier computed them (check1_stats.json, unreported_contrasts): every non-L arm is far above Z on both sets (primary one-sided p < 0.001); secondary C1-B2 +0.022 (p 0.056) NCI-60, +0.012 (p 0.16) 24Q2.
NCI-60 rules that excluded nothing here: the >=50-line rule removed no L1000-measured key, and dropping the failure-reason filter changes no killed-line count for the 419 keys.
No undefined selective r occurred in either set, so the 'undefined counts as 0' rule was never used.

Twenty development-pool drugs have no connectivity block (no structure); no query matches the pool by name or by Broad ID either (19Q4 treatment info), so the pool-overlap rule is satisfied beyond the ik14 test.
Sealing: the verifier read only the ID column of every 24Q2 matrix row and parsed values only for the 101 query rows the run used. BRD-K57796080's row was not read.
Forbidden files (gat_*.py, DEV_LOG.md, dev/, run logs) were never opened for reading; gat_*.py and DEV_LOG.md were hashed as opaque bytes for check 5, and dev/ files were not hashed.

No DEVIATIONS.md exists in the study folder; all freeze-bound files hash-match and none was modified after 04:53:24Z. Timeline (UTC): matrix created 04:53:39Z, modified 04:53:48Z; prism24q2.npz 04:54:34Z; NCI-60 run outputs 04:58:55Z; 24Q2 outputs 04:59:17Z.
The maintained module (src/virtual_cell/transcriptional_transfer.py) was used only as a secondary cross-check; it agrees with the verifier's implementation to 6e-16.

REPORT.md was not written: the agent harness refused a report .md file from a subagent, so the report text was returned to the caller. The xlsx caches made by v02_parse_xlsx.py (221 MB) were deleted after use; re-run v02 first to reproduce. All freeze-bound files and RUN outputs were re-hashed at the end and are unchanged.
